column1: # Roadmap step -> plan note -> code evidence.
#   step [x] but evidence missing        -> the roadmap is lying
#   step [ ] but evidence exists         -> silently implemented, roadmap stale
#   step [x] but plan still has - [ ]    -> acceptance criteria never closed
# This is also what resolves the Plan-number vs step-number collision WITHOUT
# renaming files: Plan 07 implements step 5, Plan 00 implements step 7.
